headline: New Delhi Television Limited: Issue of Securities
sum: Issue of Securities - New Delhi Television Limited has informed the Exchange about the raising of funds through the issuance of unsecured, non-convertible perpetual debentures for an amount not exceeding Rs. 800 crores on private placement…
detail: Issue of Securities - New Delhi Television Limited has informed the Exchange about the raising of funds through the issuance of unsecured, non-convertible perpetual debentures for an amount not exceeding Rs. 800 crores on private placement basis.
